concepts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Deliver ONE compelling flat front-cover concept sketch for an adult UK vegetable-growing reference paperback, portrait 185:240 proportion. Fill the image with the cover, no physical book mockup or outer presentation board. This is a NEW DESIGN FROM SCRATCH.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the OLD cover, ONLY a reference for palette and illustration style. Its composition was rejected: DO NOT reuse its layout, diagonal carrot, interwoven type, orange subtitle ribbon, top count badges, page thumbnails, or "Veg Sorted" lettering. Images 2, 3, 4 are the APPROVED crop hero illustrations: match their crisply drawn, richly coloured, simplified editorial vegetables, glossy graphic highlights, fresh green foliage and slight dimensional shading. The black around these reference vegetables is transparency; do not reproduce the glow/black backgrounds. Image 5 is a real inside page: absorb its confident chunky type, cream ground and family-coloured circles, not its page layout or detailed copy.
The new title is exactly "The Vegetable Guru". Subtitle exactly "Your at-a-glance growing companion". A quieter bottom line exactly "44 at-a-glance growing guides & 14 troubleshooting guides", neatly broken over two lines if necessary. Include these three text elements accurately, no other text. Do not add author, price, review quotes, fictional awards, logos or guru characters. "Guru" means a useful authoritative reference, not a human mascot or religious imagery. Large confident rounded display lettering with an adult editorial feel. Title readable at small thumbnail size, subtitle clear. Vegetable-growing, not a recipe book. Rich forest green, warm cream, vivid orange, leafy green, beetroot magenta, tomato red; limited confident colour. No vintage botanical engraving, kraft paper, watercolour, chalkboard, decorative borders or stock-photo realism. Make an eye-catching colourful designed concept with clean typography and fully realised artwork, not a pencil scribble.
DIRECTION 1: THE HARVEST CROWN. A bright cream cover with a commanding, carefully typeset title occupying the upper half: small "The", very large "Vegetable", exceptionally bold huge "Guru" in forest green. Typography stays horizontal, precise, and beautifully spaced. Beneath the title, the subtitle is calm dark green text on bare cream, no ribbon. The lower half is one spectacular sculptural FAN of oversized vegetables: a huge bright carrot leaning outward, purple cut onion, scarlet tomato, curled pea pod and frilly green/purple kale. The vegetables rise into a broad harvest crown from the bottom edge, behind the very lowest edges of the title but never over letter counters. Their scale and confident asymmetry make this feel exuberant and premium, with few large shapes rather than dozens of small ones. A pale spring-green disc partly behind the harvest connects subtly to the inner pages. Bottom line on a clean cream baseline. Lots of contrast and air around the title. This is a typographic cover above a monumental harvest arrangement, NOT the old cover’s sprawling diagonal illustration.

DIRECTION 2: AT A GLANCE. A bold contemporary graphic BLOCK-GRID cover, like a visually arresting modern reference book. Absolutely different from the old cover and a conventional harvest pile. Arrange an asymmetric grid of large flat-colour rectangles with crisp edges and virtually no gutters. Upper left ~62% width × 64% height is deep forest green containing huge warm-cream title stacked "The" / "Vegetable" / "Guru", with the subtitle below in smaller warm cream, all horizontal left aligned with generous inset. Upper right ~38% width is two dramatic illustration blocks: vivid orange background with a large cut purple onion, and pale lime background with a scarlet tomato. Lower ~36% height is a row of three strongly cropped editorial vegetable illustrations on alternating cream, apricot and pale green: upright bright orange carrots, frilled kale with purple veins, curving pea pod. Let one leaf cross one block edge for life, but the title panel stays clean. Each vegetable is unusually large and beautiful, matching the hero references. Bottom cover line on a clean cream footer band. Sophisticated clear hierarchy and bold graphic rhythm; no boxes of small instructional text, no tiny icon soup.

DIRECTION 3: ABOVE AND BELOW. A striking illustrated garden cutaway that instantly says GROWING, not cooking. A deep forest-green upper sky occupies around the top 60%, carrying immense warm-cream title "The Vegetable Guru" over three carefully balanced lines, with "Guru" the largest. The small first line "The" sits neatly over "Vegetable", no circular title plaque. The subtitle sits cleanly in warm cream below the title. Below this, a gently sloping ground line crosses the cover around 63% down. A lively row of green leaves and short stems grow upward around the lower edges of the lettering without hiding text. The lower 37% is a single warm apricot soil cutaway, with beautifully drawn large orange carrots, magenta beetroot and purple onion bulbs shown rooted in the earth at different heights, with a few elegant fine roots. They are growing plants, not loose produce hovering in soil. Match the vivid, clean, slightly dimensional vector-like illustration language of the approved heroes, no photorealistic mud. A simple large pale-orange sun is partially cropped at the upper right corner, away from all lettering, providing one daring accent. Keep the gardening anatomy plausible and the title dominant. Bottom cover line in forest green in a clean quiet part of the apricot ground. An assured illustrated book jacket, not a children's educational poster. No human face, gnome, spiritual motifs or literal guru.

review: All three generated fronts visually inspected: title, subtitle and guide-count line correctly rendered and legible. Intended decorative vegetable crops retained. Concept 3 is an illustrative cutaway, not planting guidance. Unapproved; final typography, drawing details, resolution, bleed and back/spine require development after selection.
